intent: I moved the two rear sensors further back from y = -0.01 to y = -0.02 to enable earlier detection of sharp turns, as requested by the integrator's feedback. I also increased the wheel track from 0.16 to 0.17 to enhance lateral stability during turns. I kept the sensor size at 0.016 as it already improved noise robustness. These changes should help reduce line loss events and off-track terminations by giving the controller better early line information and a more stable platform, improving completion rates and progress.
rationale: The race data shows the robot still fails to complete tracks with one line loss event per run, indicating the controller has not fully exploited the geometry improvements yet. The integrator requested moving rear sensors further back (y from -0.01 to -0.02) to detect turns earlier and increasing wheel track from 0.16 to 0.17 for better stability. Moving rear sensors back should provide earlier line detection on sharp turns, allowing the controller to react sooner and reduce line loss. Increasing wheel track should improve stability during turns, helping maintain control and reduce off-track events. Sensor size remains at 0.016 to maintain noise robustness. I expect these changes to improve line following performance, reduce line loss events, and increase completion and progress metrics. I request measurements of completion, progress, completion_time, rms_error, and line_loss_events to verify these hypotheses in the next race.
